rule: Equity-timing entrants must have an appraisal ratio > 0.3 on 2010-06..2022-12: regress the sleeve's daily returns on ES/NQ 50/50 buy-and-hold returns (2010-22); the residual (intercept + error) annualised Sharpe must exceed 0.3, in addition to the sleeve Sharpe > 0.3
registered: 2026-10-20, refined before any further test (first version 'beat buy-and-hold Sharpe' wrongly penalised sporadic sleeves)
why: Gen209's VR2/TS2 were invested 84-92% of the time (corr 0.83-0.88 with buy-and-hold): their Sharpe was beta; the appraisal ratio removes beta
applies to: Gen208/208b, Gen210 NKD, and every equity-timing test from Gen224 on
